threads.body: This handler catches errors from the scenario-local `get_weather` call and argument lookup; the Assistants SDK neither invokes the callable nor receives its exception. These events cannot be captured by SDK instrumentation, contrary to `.github/instructions/evaluate-reference.instructions.md:17-31`. Remove the new application-only exception instrumentation and its README claim; the OpenAI Agents scenario can remain the SDK-backed proof.
